title: Entering a New EU Market? Build the Operational Blueprint Before You Build the Campaign
note: Render on the Mac: BlogAnnounce.tsx + the cloned voice. Output blog-announce-video.mp4 into this folder.

beats.vo: Most founders entering Europe do it completely backwards.
Germany, Denmark, Switzerland — these markets are not interchangeable.
One English campaign across all of them is not a strategy.
Audit the market before AI touches a single piece of content.
Then AI handles speed and scale. A human handles judgment and stakes.
The full blueprint is in the blog link in the comments.
